thought.text: The 401 is likely a token-authorization issue for the DELETE method. Let me try once more and verify the login command from the guide works verbatim.

reasoning_content: The deletion attempt hit authentication issues with the token service, but that's just a limitation of my cleanup process rather than a problem with Harbor itself. My test push and pull operations worked fine, so the installation is solid. I'll try the deletion one more time with a fresh token, and if it doesn't work, I'll move on since the test image is just a small dev artifact. I also noticed the VERSION file shows 2.16.0 but the deployment is running v2.15.0 tags — that's just a difference between the fork's development version and the release tag being used.

action.command:
echo '--- guide login command verbatim ---'
echo 'Harbor12345' | docker login localhost:80 -u admin --password-stdin
echo '--- retry tag delete with fresh token ---'
TOKEN=$(curl -s -X POST http://localhost/c/token -d 'grant_type=password&username=admin&password=Harbor12345' | tr -d '"' | sed 's/^[^=]*=//')
DIGEST='sha256:7cefa58bd70cbf86bb0ef44b9c27a9c6a633763977ea40868d1bfe9278967b25'
curl -s -X DELETE -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -w '\nHTTP %{http_code}\n' "http://localhost/api/v2.0/projects/library/repositories/alpine/artifacts/${DIGEST}/tags/validation-test"
sleep 2; curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" http://localhost/v2/library/alpine/tags/list
